about:
Patients Care Medical Supply Inc is based in Maurice, Louisiana, a small community in the Acadiana region. The company operates as a locally owned and operated provider of durable medical equipment (DME), serving Lafayette, Youngsville, Broussard, Abbeville, New Iberia, and surrounding areas. Founding year and founders are not disclosed in public materials.

The company supplies a range of home medical equipment including mobility aids such as wheelchairs and walkers, CPAP and respiratory therapy devices, bathroom safety products, wound care supplies, catheters, and other home health essentials. Services include free in-home delivery across Acadiana, hospital discharge assistance to help patients transition home with necessary equipment, and insurance billing for Medicare, Medicaid, and most major private insurers. Facility size, headcount, and order volumes are not published.

Customers include patients recovering at home, family caregivers, and healthcare professionals seeking equipment solutions in the Acadiana region. The company accepts Medicare, Medicaid, FSA/HSA, major credit cards, and CareCredit. Concrete examples from reviews mention wheelchair purchases, hospital bed delivery and assembly, and gel pad consultations.

The company states its mission is to revive the tradition of personalized service akin to family doctor house calls, blending timeless values with technology to keep patient well-being the top priority. It emphasizes knowledgeable guidance, fast service, and ongoing support tailored to each patient's unique needs.

old_description: Our company specializes in food distribution and owns refrigerated trucks and vans capable of delivering any type of dry, chilled and frozen product. about:
Paxs Foods, doing business as Paxs Distributors, is headquartered in Gardena, California. The company operates a food distribution and processing business focused on serving Japanese markets across the United States.

The company provides a range of services including food distribution, food processing, international import, storage, and transportation. It owns a fleet of refrigerated trucks and vans capable of handling dry, chilled, and frozen products. Paxs Foods emphasizes a complete in-house operation that covers purchasing, inspection, sorting, and shipping. The company also produces its own line of original food products, such as bento boxes, sushi rice, and noodles.

Paxs Foods primarily serves Japanese grocery markets in Los Angeles and San Diego, delivering directly via its own fleet. It also ships products to customers on the West Coast, East Coast, and in Hawaii through third-party freight carriers. Its customer base includes wholesale and retail outlets specializing in Japanese food products.

The company distinguishes itself by maintaining full control over the supply chain, from procurement to final delivery, which it describes as uncommon among food wholesalers. This integrated approach allows it to manage quality and temperature requirements for perishable Japanese food items.

name: Peak Manufacturing and Fulfillment
old_description: Single source solution delivering high volume, high quality manufacturing and fulfillment services to industrial and consumer product companies for almost 40 years
about:
Peak Manufacturing and Fulfillment was founded in 2015 in Englewood, Colorado. The company draws on nearly four decades of manufacturing and assembly experience, operating as an integrated production and fulfillment enterprise. No founder names or ownership structure are publicly disclosed.

The facility runs a standardized fleet of Nissei injection molding presses—hydraulic, electric, and hybrid—ranging from 22 to 720 tons, supported by robotics, automation, and secondary screws for clear polymer production. Personnel are trained in scientific decoupled molding and work with all thermoplastic materials. Beyond molding, Peak provides design and engineering consultation, prototyping, assembly and kitting, custom packaging, warehousing with 24/7 inventory visibility, and fulfillment and shipping services that leverage combined purchasing power for discounted carrier rates.

Peak serves medical device manufacturers, consumer and industrial product companies, and shelf-stable food brands. Its customers range from startups needing warehousing and automated shipping to mid-sized and large businesses seeking a single-source partner for design, production, packaging, and distribution.

The company emphasizes its "complex circular structure" that consolidates design, development, and distribution under one roof. Affiliation with sister company Caroba Plastics and packaging supplier Pozzetta Specialty Supplies extends purchasing power and packaging capabilities. Peak’s stated mission is to understand each client’s logistical needs and deliver simple, scalable solutions.

name: Pearson Medical Technologies LLC
old_description: Pearson Medical Technologies: Revolutionizing Pharmacy Automation
about:
Pearson Medical Technologies LLC was founded in 1996 in Alexandria, Louisiana. The company has spent over three decades developing pharmacy automation technology, marking its 30th anniversary with a focus on unit dose packaging and barcode labeling systems.

The company designs and manufactures its own line of pharmacy automation equipment, including the m:Print® v4 barcode labeling software with 1-Click Print® Technology, the intelliCount® Automated Universal Feeder, and the Fillin Station™ Automated Feeder. All products are produced in the United States. The software automates drug information capture, label template selection, beyond-use date calculation, and packaging initiation, while the feeders operate without custom canisters for unattended or high-speed tabletop packaging.

Pearson Medical Technologies serves pharmacies, hospitals, long-term care facilities, and retail pharmacies across the United States, with installations reported in Florida, Pennsylvania, Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, New York, and Illinois, as well as internationally. Its solutions target medication packaging, dispensing accuracy, and regulatory compliance such as the Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA).

The company differentiates itself by offering two non-canister automated feeder options, a feature it claims is unique in the market. Its 1-Click Print® Technology eliminates manual keyboarding for most packaging runs, and the company reports a 99.9% dispensing accuracy rate across facilities. Patient safety and DSCSA compliance are cited as core drivers behind its product development.

name: Pelham Plastics Inc
old_description: Our dramatic growth stems from an unwavering focus on the most important part of our business: understanding our customers and solving their challenges.
about:
Pelham Plastics Inc operates from Pelham, New Hampshire. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its capabilities page describes its origins as a customer-centric venture built on an "open-door philosophy" emphasizing teamwork and one-on-one relationships.

The company provides full injection and insert molding for thermoplastic materials, along with over-molding, RF thermoforming, and embedded marker band integration. Its single-source facility includes a tool room capable of producing single-cavity prototype molds up to multi-cavity Class 101 production tooling, plus 3D printing, mold flow analysis, and assembly services performed in white room environments. Engineering support spans R&D, design assistance, and scientific molding principles backed by lean manufacturing initiatives such as 6S and Kaizen.

Pelham Plastics serves the medical device industry, producing components and assemblies that are inserted into the human body. A 2020 Plastics News article highlighted the company's solution for a medical marker problem, and its quality page notes that many products are destined for implantation. The firm also partners with community organizations such as the Humane Society for Greater Nashua.

The company says its differentiation lies in a collaborative, customer-first approach combined with rigorous quality systems. It holds ISO 13485:2016 certification and reports zero observations from its most recent audit. Scientific molding, design for manufacture, and design for six sigma practices are cited as core to its process development.

name: Peliton Plastics
old_description: Peliton was founded in 1996 by Robert McKinnon. We began with
about:
Peliton Plastics was founded in 1996 by Robert McKinnon in Valdosta, Georgia. The company remains family-owned and operates from a 35,000-square-foot facility in South Georgia, where it has built a full-service plastic injection molding and contract manufacturing operation over nearly three decades.

The shop runs 55- to 650-ton molding machines capable of shot sizes from 0.001 to 5 pounds, processing a wide range of thermoplastics and engineered resins. Beyond molding, Peliton provides insert molding, overmolding, in-house mold making and repair (including EDM and mold texturing), CNC milling, turning, and grinding, as well as pad and screen printing on plastics, vinyl, metal, and glass. Assembly services include ultrasonic welding, kitting, packaging, and shipping, while a 3D printing capability supports prototyping and low-volume runs.

Customers span medical devices, agriculture, automotive, kitchen products, toys, pest control, industrial components, electronic enclosures, promotional products, home and office goods, and tools. The company also works directly with inventors, offering NDA-protected development from concept to market-ready product.

Peliton emphasizes domestic production as a differentiator: all tooling, molding, finishing, and printing occur under one roof, eliminating overseas shipping delays and protecting intellectual property. The team specializes in reshoring projects, offering fast partial-order shipments and direct access to the production floor for real-time communication.

name: Pemberton's Gourmet Foods
old_description: Pemberton’s core values aren’t just words. They guide every aspect of our work—and have for over two decades.
about:
Pemberton's Gourmet Foods operates from Gray, Maine, where it has served as a contract manufacturing partner for food brands across New England for more than two decades. The company was founded to provide co-packing and private-label services to restaurateurs and consumer-packaged-goods entrepreneurs, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The facility specializes in hot-fill and cold-fill production of sauces, salsas, preserves, jams, jellies, mustards, relishes, condiments, marinades, dessert toppings, tapenades, chutneys, and salad dressings. Services extend beyond filling to include product development, process-review coordination, and ingredient and nutritional labeling. The company also produces its own line of specialty foods sold through retail outlets in Maine and the Northeast.

Customers range from independent food entrepreneurs and restaurant owners to established CPG brands and food brokers. A noted partnership includes Reny's, a 19-location Maine department store that develops private-label products with Pemberton's. Testimonials cite reliability on rush orders and protection of proprietary formulations.

The company emphasizes guaranteed craftsmanship, customer-first service, and confidentiality of client recipes as its differentiating principles. It holds SQF certification and positions itself as a start-to-finish partner that manages production details so clients can focus on brand growth.

name: Pendable Packaging Inc.
old_description: Locally owned and operated thermoforming facility that has been in operation since 1998. We take pride in our quality products, affordable custom thermoformed parts and timely deliveries.
about:
Pendable Packaging Inc. operates a thermoforming facility in Farwell, Michigan, where it has been locally owned and operated since its founding in 1998. The company began as a custom thermoforming shop focused on producing protective packaging for manufacturers across multiple sectors.

The facility specializes in vacuum and pressure thermoforming, transforming plastic sheets such as PET, PVC, polystyrene, and polypropylene into custom packaging components. In-house design experts collaborate with tooling partners to develop molds, while the production line handles heating, forming, cooling, and trimming. The company emphasizes material flexibility, allowing customers to select thickness and resin type to optimize formability, strength, and cost.

Pendable serves the automotive, aerospace, agriculture, consumer goods, electronics, pharmaceutical, renewable energy, military, and hunting/fishing industries. Customers include manufacturers needing packaging that orients parts for automated assembly lines, protects components during transit, or enhances retail presentation. The company also produces packaging for agricultural and renewable-energy applications using recycled materials.

The company differentiates itself through its in-house design and tooling partnerships, open material capabilities, and a commitment to eco-friendly practices such as recycled-content packaging. It positions its service as a balance of quality and budget, aiming to reduce material waste and deliver timely shipments.

Peninsula Plastics Company, Inc. was founded in 1980 as a family-owned business in Auburn Hills, Michigan, with a manufacturing plant in Pontiac, Michigan.

The company specializes in thermoformed plastic packaging, producing rugged containers, pallets, and trays through processes that include twin-sheet thermoforming, in-house sheet extrusion, and advanced automation for high-volume runs. Its capabilities span custom design, engineering, program management, prototyping, and pattern making, all managed under one roof to maintain quality control from concept through production.

Peninsula Plastics serves a broad industrial base that includes automotive, food and beverage, system integration, retail, energy, textile, industrial equipment, warehouse and distribution, agricultural, government and military, as well as emerging sectors such as battery and renewable energy, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals, and post and parcel logistics. name: Penn Sheet Metal
old_description: Locally and family-owned, we’ve served the needs of our loyal customers since 1921. We guarantee your satisfaction with our products and services!
about:
Penn Sheet Metal operates from Allentown, Pennsylvania, where it has been locally and family-owned since 1921. The company began as a sheet metal fabrication shop serving the construction trade, though the names of its original founders are not publicly documented.

The shop specializes in architectural metals, manufacturing, and precision cutting services. Its processes include laser cutting, waterjet cutting, CNC turret punching, and CNC routing, supporting both large and small production runs. The facility produces roof panel systems (snap lock and mechanical seam), drainage products such as square and extruded downspouts and box gutters, soffits and wall panels, and metal wall panel systems. It also fabricates custom items including angle stands, bins, conveyor pans, gates, hoppers, platforms, tanks, weldments, tubing frames, and dust collection units.

Customers span the construction industry, particularly contractors and builders specifying gutter, roof, and wall panel systems. The company's architectural metal products are used in commercial and residential building projects, with concrete examples including roof panels carrying a 35-year finish warranty, drainage components, and quick-turn soffit and wall panel assemblies.

Penn Sheet Metal emphasizes its 100-plus years of experience, family ownership, and available warranties as differentiators. It offers in-store pickup and delivery, free quotes, and quick turnaround on soffit and wall panel orders to keep projects on schedule.
